item.title: Rumours circulating online about Fort St. John school in wake of shooting unfounded
item.description: School District 60 confirmed that the rumours circulating online about possible threats at Fort St. John schools have no substance.

item.title: Shooter’s father speaks about Tumbler Ridge tragedy
item.description: The father of the Tumbler Ridge shooter has spoken to share his "deepest sympathies" with the community after his child's actions on February 10th.

item.title: Live Blog: Tumbler Ridge vigil
item.description: The community of Tumbler Ridge will come together to honour and remember the victims of the February 10th, 2026 shooting starting at 6 p.m. local time. Follow the day's events using the live blog below.

item.title: Canucks beat Flyers 11-3 to take stranglehold of first-round series
item.description: The loss means the Fort St. John Senior Flyers' have to win remaining games for their best-of-seven NPHL series

item.title: Scotiabank and TD donate $400,000 in response to Tumbler Ridge shooting
item.description: Scotiabank and TD will donate a combined $400,000 to support families and community organizations following the Tumbler Ridge shooting.

item.title: Forensic work underway at school after Tumbler Ridge shooting
item.description: The BC RCMP are continuing to conduct forensic work at the Tumbler Ridge Secondary School after the deadly February 10th mass shooting in Tumbler Ridge.

item.title: Northern Health expands hours and services at Tumbler Ridge Health Centre
item.description: The Tumbler Ridge Health Centre will will be open daily from 7 a.m. to 11 p.m., including statutory holidays, from February 13th to March 6th.

item.title: ‘Tumbler Ridge strong’: Vigil held for victims of mass school shooting
item.description: A vigil was held in Tumbler Ridge for the victims of the Tumbler Ridge Secondary School mass shooting on February 10th.
